name: Summer Internship
description: Students will undertake internships within organizations to gain hands-on experience in applying OE/OC principles. The internship aims to enhance their communication skills, teamwork, and collaborative abilities, while providing exposure to real-world, industry-relevant challenges. Each student will be assigned a project by their industry supervisor and will be expected to address such problems using appropriate methodologies.
